hardGates.measurement: finite value/components; repeated same input deep-equals
same record and now across query variants has identical value
exposure/cooldown/turn metadata changes do not change value
visibility/group ACL changes do not change value
arousal 0 is accepted as 0; declared zero-valued fields have explicit policy
increase nonnegative activationCount at fixed other inputs never lowers value
increase valid nonnegative age never raises value
activation component remains finite with an explicit finite bound
emotion component remains finite and within an explicit range
each normalized input reports effective value and reason
createdAt-only input is treated by the declared alias rule
future timestamp is floored/normalized and cannot raise age factor above its age-zero value
output includes importance, activation, decay, emotion and effective input reasons
candidate diff does not touch schema/version/migration paths
candidate is a pure record+now function with no I/O or state

softMetrics.measurement: count tunable constants and normalization rules; no pass threshold is invented
report age curves, score ties, and distinguishability windows through 10 years
report pair inversions, top-K set changes, Spearman and Kendall by synthetic family
identify axes and pairs where candidates mechanically diverge; no preferred ordering label

decisionRule.hardGateFailure: candidate is rejected; soft metrics cannot compensate
decisionRule.selection: requires explicit tradeoff evidence and a canonical product rule; no weighted aggregate score
